articles.title_en: The Trouble with Rational Expectations in Heterogeneous Agent Models: A Challenge for Macroeconomics
articles.title_cn: 异质代理人模型中理性预期的困扰：对宏观经济学的挑战
articles.abstract_en: The thesis of this essay is that, in heterogeneous agent macroeconomics, the assumption of rational expectations about equilibrium prices is unrealistic and should be replaced. Rational expectations imply that decision-makers forecast equilibrium prices like interest rates by forecasting cross-sectional distributions. This leads to an extreme version of the curse of dimensionality: dynamic programming problems in which the entire distribution is a state variable (the ‘Master equation’, also known as the ‘Monster equation’). Frontier computational methods struggle with these infinite-dimensional Bellman equations, making it implausible that real-world agents solve the associated decision problems. These difficulties also limit the applicability of the heterogeneous agent approach to central questions in macroeconomics—those involving aggregate risk and non-linearities such as financial crises. This troublesome feature of the rational expectations assumption poses a challenge: what should replace it? I outline three criteria for alternative approaches: (1) computational tractability, (2) consistency with empirical evidence and (3) (some) immunity to the Lucas critique. I then discuss several promising directions, including temporary equilibrium approaches, incorporating survey expectations, least-squares learning and reinforcement learning.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文的论点是，在异质代理人宏观经济学中，关于均衡价格的理性预期假设是不现实的，应予以替换。理性预期意味着决策者通过预测横截面分布来预测均衡价格，如利率。这导致了维度灾难的极端版本：动态规划问题中整个分布成为状态变量（“主方程”，也称为“怪物方程”）。前沿计算方法难以处理这些无限维的贝尔曼方程，使得现实世界中的代理人解决相关决策问题显得不切实际。这些困难也限制了异质代理人方法在宏观经济学核心问题上的应用——涉及总风险和非线性（如金融危机）的问题。理性预期假设的这一棘手特征提出了一个挑战：应该用什么来替代它？我概述了替代方法的三个标准：（1）计算可行性，（2）与经验证据的一致性，以及（3）对卢卡斯批判的（某种程度上的）免疫性。然后，我讨论了几个有前景的方向，包括临时均衡方法、纳入调查预期、最小二乘学习和强化学习。

articles.title_en: Starting off on the Right Foot—Language Learning Classes and the Educational Success of Refugee Children
articles.title_cn: 起步正确——语言学习班与难民儿童的教育成就
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of separate preparatory language learning classes on the academic outcomes of primary school-aged immigrant children in Germany compared to their direct integration into regular classrooms. Using administrative panel data and leveraging idiosyncratic assignment of refugee children to neighbourhoods, and, consequently, schools, as well as preparatory class roll out over time, we find that primary school-aged refugees attending a preparatory class perform significantly worse on fifth-grade standardised tests and are slightly less likely to pursue an academic secondary track. While limited to short-term outcomes, our results indicate that preparatory classes could impede early academic integration by clustering migrant peers, highlighting the need to consider complementary approaches to reduce achievement disparities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了德国小学学龄移民儿童分别参加预备语言学习班与直接融入常规课堂对其学业成果的影响。利用行政面板数据，并利用难民儿童被随机分配到社区，进而分配到学校，以及预备班随时间逐步推广的情况，我们发现，参加预备班的小学学龄难民儿童在五年级标准化测试中表现显著较差，并且升入学术型中学轨道的可能性略低。虽然仅限于短期成果，我们的结果表明，预备班可能通过聚集移民同伴而阻碍早期学业融合，这凸显了考虑补充方法以减少成就差距的必要性。

articles.title_en: The Productivity of Public and Private Preschools (and Schools): Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 公立与私立幼儿园（及学校）的生产率：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the relative productivity of private and public institutions at the preschool and primary school levels using panel data from 215 villages in Tamil Nadu. Private preschools show higher test score value-added in math and language (${\sim} 0.59 \!-\!0.74\sigma\!$) and outperform government providers in nearly all villages. This productivity difference explains 60% of the socioeconomic test score gap before school entry. These results contrast starkly with primary schooling, where we find no evidence of a private-sector premium in math and negative effects in local language. Test score value-added is positively correlated between private and government options in a village, both at the preschool and primary school levels. Quality is also correlated across levels; villages with more productive primary schools also tend to have more productive preschools. Our findings inform debates on achieving universal foundational skills and highlight the need to improve the quality of preschools available to lower-income families.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用泰米尔纳德邦215个村庄的面板数据，研究了私立和公立机构在幼儿园和小学阶段的生产率相对差异。私立幼儿园在数学和语言方面的测试成绩增值更高（${\sim} 0.59 \!-\!0.74\sigma\!$），并且在几乎所有村庄中都优于政府提供的服务。这种生产率差异解释了入学前社会经济测试成绩差距的60%。这些结果与小学教育形成鲜明对比，在小学阶段，我们没有发现私立部门在数学方面的溢价证据，并且在当地语言方面存在负面影响。在一个村庄内，私立和公立选项的测试成绩增值呈正相关，无论是在幼儿园还是小学阶段。质量也跨级别相关；小学生产率较高的村庄，其幼儿园生产率往往也较高。我们的发现为关于实现普遍基础技能的辩论提供了信息，并强调了改善低收入家庭可获得的幼儿园质量的必要性。

articles.title_en: Income Tax and the Residential Mobility of Top Income Earners: Evidence from US and UK Households in Switzerland
articles.title_cn: 所得税与高收入者的居住流动性：来自瑞士的美国和英国家庭证据
articles.abstract_en: We provide quasi-experimental evidence on the income tax-induced residential mobility of foreign high-income households living in Switzerland by exploiting the differential tax treatment of UK and US households. While the two groups are similar in terms of non-tax sorting preferences, US households are effectively insulated from Swiss income taxation due to the US worldwide income tax system. Thus, they provide the control group for the UK households, our treatment group. Comparing the residential choices of the two groups within a forty-five-minutes commuting zone of Zurich, we robustly find a residential location elasticity with respect to the net-of-tax rate of around eight. This estimate captures the ‘pure’ income tax effect on residential choice, not being downward biased by non-tax location incentives (that positively correlate with income taxes) and, for instance, by coordination costs between job and residential choices.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过利用英国和美国家庭的差别税收待遇，提供了关于外国高收入家庭在瑞士居住流动性受所得税影响的准实验证据。虽然这两组在非税收排序偏好方面相似，但由于美国的全球所得税制度，美国家庭实际上不受瑞士所得税的影响。因此，他们为我们的处理组——英国家庭提供了对照组。比较两组在苏黎世四十五分钟通勤区内的居住选择，我们稳健地发现，相对于税后收入率的居住地点弹性约为八。这一估计捕捉了所得税对居住选择的‘纯’影响，不会因非税收地点激励（与所得税正相关）以及例如工作与居住选择之间的协调成本而产生向下偏差。

articles.title_en: To Savour Consumption or To Confront Dread: The Hedonic Opportunity Cost of Attention
articles.title_cn: 品味消费还是直面恐惧：注意力的享乐机会成本
articles.abstract_en: People face a fundamental trade-off between savouring consumption in the present and processing information. Both require attention, which is limited. As a result, directing attention to one necessarily comes at the expense of the other. We study this attentional opportunity cost, focusing on cases where information concerns potentially distressing future outcomes. Across four experiments, we find that higher present consumption reduces demand for such information and increases willingness to pay for risk mitigation. These findings have implications for models of anticipatory utility, self-regulation under limited attention and the political economy of distraction—helping to explain, for instance, why political actors might suppress demand for information by offering ‘bread and circuses’.
articles.abstract_cn: 人们在品味当下消费与处理信息之间面临一个基本的权衡。两者都需要注意力，而注意力是有限的。因此，将注意力导向一方必然以牺牲另一方为代价。我们研究这种注意力的机会成本，重点关注信息涉及潜在令人痛苦的未来结果的情形。在四项实验中，我们发现，更高的当前消费会降低对此类信息的需求，并增加为风险缓解支付的意愿。这些发现对预期效用模型、有限注意力下的自我调节以及分心的政治经济学具有启示意义——例如，有助于解释为什么政治行为者可能通过提供“面包与马戏”来抑制对信息的需求。

articles.title_en: Contrasting the Local and National Demographic Incidence of Local Labour Demand Shocks
articles.title_cn: 对比地方与全国人口统计意义上的地方劳动力需求冲击影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how spatial frictions that differ among heterogeneous workers and establishments shape the geographic and demographic incidence of alternative local labour demand shocks, with implications for the appropriate level of government at which to fund local economic initiatives. Longitudinal Employer-Household Dynamics data featuring millions of job transitions facilitate estimation of a rich two-sided labour market assignment model. The model generates simulated forecasts of many alternative local demand shocks featuring different establishment compositions and local areas. Workers within 10 miles receive only 11.2% (6.6%) of nationwide welfare (employment) short-run gains, with at least 35.9% (62.0%) accruing to out-of-state workers, despite much larger per-worker impacts for the closest workers. Local incidence by demographic category is very sensitive to shock composition, but different shocks produce similar demographic incidence further from the shock. Furthermore, the remaining heterogeneity in incidence at the state or national level can reverse patterns of heterogeneous demographic impacts at the local level. Overall, the results suggest that reduced-form approaches using distant locations as controls can produce accurate estimates of local shock impacts on local workers, but that the distribution of local impacts badly approximates shocks’ statewide or national incidence.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了在异质性工人和机构之间不同的空间摩擦如何塑造不同地方劳动力需求冲击的地理和人口统计影响，并探讨了其对地方政府资助地方经济倡议的适当层级的启示。包含数百万次工作转换的纵向雇主-家庭动态数据有助于估计一个丰富的双边劳动力市场分配模型。该模型生成了对许多不同地方需求冲击的模拟预测，这些冲击具有不同的机构构成和地方区域。10英里内的工人仅获得全国福利（就业）短期收益的11.2%（6.6%），而至少35.9%（62.0%）的收益归于州外工人，尽管对最近的工人人均影响要大得多。按人口统计类别划分的地方影响对冲击构成非常敏感，但不同的冲击在距离冲击较远的地方产生相似的人口统计影响。此外，州或国家层面影响中剩余的异质性可能逆转地方层面异质性人口统计影响的模式。总体而言，结果表明，使用遥远地点作为对照的简化形式方法可以准确估计地方冲击对地方工人的影响，但地方影响的分布并不能很好地近似冲击的州或全国影响。

articles.title_en: Breaking the Iron Rice Bowl: Tenure-Track Systems and the Rise of Academic Innovation in China
articles.title_cn: 打破铁饭碗：中国终身教职轨道制度与学术创新的兴起
articles.abstract_en: This study leverages personnel system reforms within economics departments at Chinese universities to assess the impact of the tenure-track system on research productivity. Using individual-level data on faculty members, we show that tenure-track faculty produce 0.135 (or 100%) more publications in high-quality journals annually during their probationary period compared to faculty hired under the traditional personnel system. Our findings suggest that this increase in productivity is driven by the recruitment of high-potential researchers, heightened pressure due to performance-based employment risks and enhanced incentives, including higher salaries and increased research funding. Moreover, we observe that the varied implementation details influence the actual effects of the reform. Overall, the university tenure-track reform has been a significant contributor to the increased productivity in Chinese economic research.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用中国大学经济系的人事制度改革，评估终身教职轨道制度对研究生产力的影响。基于教师个人层面的数据，我们显示，在试用期内，终身教职轨道教师相较于传统人事制度下聘用的教师，每年在高品质期刊上发表的论文数量多出0.135篇（或100%）。我们的发现表明，这种生产力的提升是由招募高潜力研究者、基于绩效的就业风险带来的压力增强以及包括更高薪酬和更多研究经费在内的激励增加所驱动的。此外，我们观察到，不同的实施细节会影响改革的实际效果。总体而言，大学终身教职轨道改革对中国经济研究生产力的提升做出了重要贡献。

articles.title_en: Procedural Barriers to Political Candidacy: Gender, Discouragement and Candidate Persistence
articles.title_cn: 竞选公职的程序性障碍：性别、挫败感与候选人持续性
articles.abstract_en: A procedural rule in Indian elections requires candidates to pay a nominal deposit, which is forfeited on obtaining fewer than one-sixth of the votes. Forfeiture diminishes female recontesting by 13.3 percentage points in the following election (relative effect size of 68%). We find no such effects for men. These effects are persistent and discourage female candidates in the long term as well. States with more regressive gender norms exhibit stronger findings, with female forfeiters also being 11.8 percentage points less likely to win the following election. We enhance our analysis by conducting a survey experiment with representative voters.
articles.abstract_cn: 印度选举中的一项程序性规则要求候选人支付名义保证金，若得票率低于六分之一，该保证金将被没收。保证金被没收使女性在下次选举中再次参选的可能性降低13.3个百分点（相对效应大小为68%）。我们未发现对男性存在此类影响。这些效应具有持续性，并长期挫伤女性候选人的积极性。在性别规范更为保守的邦中，效应更为显著，女性保证金被没收者在下次选举中获胜的可能性也降低11.8个百分点。我们通过一项针对代表性选民的调查实验来增强分析。

articles.title_en: Product Market Monopolies and Labour Market Monopsonies
articles.title_cn: 产品市场垄断与劳动力市场买方垄断
articles.abstract_en: This paper unveils a novel externality of product market regulation in the labour market. It shows theoretically and empirically that higher barriers to entry in product markets translate into higher employers’ labour market power, measured by the wage markdown—the ratio between the marginal product of labour and the wage. Using quasi-exogenous variation in investment restrictions across 389 manufacturing product markets in Indonesia, the analysis finds that wage markdowns would have been almost 10% lower without restrictions and workers would have earned a larger fraction of their marginal product. The analysis supports the model’s prediction that lower entry is the main driver of the positive relationship between investment restrictions and wage markdowns, and that restrictions increase markdowns more in commuting zones where employers have already substantial labour market power. The restrictions do not affect employment, consistent with recent models based on search frictions and wage bargaining, but not with classical monopsony models.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文揭示了产品市场管制在劳动力市场中的一种新颖外部性。理论上和实证上均表明，产品市场进入壁垒越高，雇主的劳动力市场势力越强，这通过工资加成率——即劳动边际产品与工资之比——来衡量。利用印度尼西亚389个制造业产品市场中投资限制的准外生变化，分析发现，若无限制，工资加成率将几乎降低10%，工人将获得其边际产品的更大份额。分析支持模型的预测，即较低的进入率是投资限制与工资加成率正相关关系的主要驱动因素，且限制在雇主已拥有显著劳动力市场势力的通勤区域中增加加成率的效果更强。这些限制不影响就业，这与基于搜索摩擦和工资谈判的近期模型一致，但与经典买方垄断模型不符。

articles.title_en: Education Competition and Fertility Intention: Evidence from China’s Private Tutoring Ban
articles.title_cn: 教育竞争与生育意愿：来自中国校外培训禁令的证据
articles.abstract_en: Low fertility presents a major challenge for many nations. We study whether restricting competition-driven private tutoring can enhance fertility intentions by analysing China’s 2021 private tutoring ban. Using nationwide surveys, we elicit respondents’ fertility intentions under scenarios with and without the policy. The tutoring ban significantly increases expected total fertility by 7%–8%, with larger effects in cities under greater policy intensity. Decomposition reveals that the primary driver is perceived reduction in educational competition, followed by improved parental health, parent-child relationships, and reduced time and monetary costs. We also find consistent results on actual birth rates three years after the policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 低生育率对许多国家构成重大挑战。我们通过分析中国2021年的校外培训禁令，研究限制竞争驱动的私人补习是否能增强生育意愿。利用全国性调查，我们获取了受访者在有政策和无政策情景下的生育意愿。校外培训禁令显著提高了预期总生育率，增幅为7%–8%，在政策执行力度更大的城市中效果更为显著。分解分析显示，主要驱动因素是对教育竞争感知的降低，其次是父母健康状况的改善、亲子关系的提升以及时间和金钱成本的减少。我们还发现，政策实施三年后，实际出生率也呈现出一致的结果。

articles.title_en: Electoral Incentives to Obtain EU Grants
articles.title_cn: 获取欧盟拨款的选举激励
articles.abstract_en: Political agency models predict that electoral concerns induce politicians to put effort into making policies that benefit citizens. We exploit the introduction of mayoral term limits in Portugal to investigate how electoral incentives affect incumbents’ efforts to obtain EU grants. We focus on EU grants because getting them requires effort. Moreover, by obtaining EU grants, mayors can do more for their citizens. We focus on Portugal because it provides a quasi-natural experimental setting to determine the causal effect of electoral incentives on effort. We find that term-limited mayors receive about 30% less EU money than mayors eligible for re-election.
articles.abstract_cn: 政治代理模型预测，选举关切促使政治家投入努力制定有利于公民的政策。我们利用葡萄牙市长任期限制的引入，研究选举激励如何影响现任者获取欧盟拨款的努力。我们关注欧盟拨款，因为获取这些拨款需要付出努力。此外，通过获取欧盟拨款，市长可以为公民做更多事情。我们聚焦于葡萄牙，因为它提供了一个准自然实验环境，以确定选举激励对努力的因果效应。我们发现，受任期限制的市长获得的欧盟资金比有资格连任的市长少约30%。
